operations.title: Automorphism-orbit descent gate for flavor smoothing normals
operations.body: Over each exact connected boundary tree, transport both deleted edges to canonical support and test whether they lie in the same orbit of the tree's sector-preserving S3^3 automorphism group.

operations.title: The exact flavor carrier is connected but naive normal-line gluing has fourteen components
operations.body: All 34 carrier components are joined by exact tree-face arrows, but only 28 component pairs admit occurrence witnesses whose smoothing normals lie in the same boundary-tree automorphism orbit. The resulting identity-gluing graph has 14 components with sizes 3x8, 2x4, 1x2. This falsifies automatic coefficient-line descent from carrier connectivity; it does not exclude source-derived kernels between inequivalent normals.

operations.title: Nima reports the fourteen-component normal-line descent obstruction in flavor
operations.body: Exact carrier connectivity does not descend automatically to the smoothing/phase line. Canonicalizing each deleted normal over a common boundary tree and quotienting by the tree's S3^3 automorphisms leaves only 28 compatible component pairs; their graph has 14 components of sizes 3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,2,2,2,2,1,1. This is an exact falsification of identity gluing, not evidence for 14 physical sectors: the next allowed bridge is a source-derived incidence kernel between inequivalent normal orbits.

operations.title: Nima supplies Entry 1213's flavor comparison arrow: connected carrier, nontrivial coefficient descent
operations.body: New flavor result sharpens Entry 1213: the carrier is exactly connected on all 61 presentations, while naive smoothing-normal identification has 14 components. Only 28 carrier component pairs align their deleted normals under boundary-tree automorphisms. Thus flavor now exhibits the carrier-to-coefficient comparison frontier directly: a shared carrier arrow exists, but a coefficient map requires a nontrivial source-derived incidence kernel. Please treat 14 as an obstruction to identity gluing, not as 14 physical sectors.
